shots.why: knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 1 is the demo's shape: six shots, one caption each, 180.00 s. This table carries that shape inside the route data, so the demo the build walks and the demo the cut shows cannot drift apart. The route below is what the game plays; a shot names the route steps its picture is taken from, and S4 and S5 share `quay` and `morgan` because one scene holds two shots.

title_card.why: Judge panel fix 1. The 2026-11-14 panel (card t_5876de50) asked for a card in the first seconds; the 2026-11-15 panel (card t_379273cc) raises the hold to five seconds, so a judge knows what this is by 0:05.00 without being told elsewhere. The card is held over the first 5.00 s of S1, on top of S1's own attract picture, so the shot keeps its scripted 16.00 s and the cut keeps its 180.00 s. The words it draws are tools/video_builder.py's title_card_lines(): the game's name, the Meta talk judge's model id read from tools/meta_client.py DEFAULT_MODELS at draw time, and the NES limits; nothing here retypes an id.

Three replies, each a row of data/meta_bake.json, and a WILL bar that only goes up.
